mapper.sql: select s.id, s.teacher_user_id, s.subject, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.source, s.fee_id, s.fee_schedule_id, s.edited_flag, s.del_flag, s.remark, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, u.nick_name as teacher_name, (select count(1) from cf_schedule_student st where st.session_id = s.id) as student_count from cf_schedule_session s left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.teacher_user_id
mapper.select: select st.id, st.session_id, st.student_id, st.create_by, st.create_time, cs.name as student_name, cs.avatar as student_avatar from cf_schedule_student st left join cf_student cs on cs.id = st.student_id where st.session_id = #{sessionId} order by cs.name, st.id
where s.del_flag = '0' and s.fee_id = #{feeId} and s.edited_flag = '0' and s.source = 'fee'
mapper.insert: insert into cf_schedule_session (teacher_user_id, subject, start_time, end_time, source, fee_id, fee_schedule_id, edited_flag, del_flag, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{teacherUserId}, #{subject}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{source}, #{feeId}, #{feeScheduleId}, #{editedFlag}, #{delFlag}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update:
update cf_schedule_session
teacher_user_id = #{teacherUserId}, subject = #{subject}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, source = #{source}, fee_id = #{feeId}, fee_schedule_id = #{feeScheduleId}, edited_flag = #{editedFlag}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime},
where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert:
insert into cf_schedule_student (session_id, student_id, create_by, create_time) values
(#{item.sessionId}, #{item.studentId}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime})
